policy: Orbis never puts firmware in a redistributable archive unless redistribution rights are established and recorded here. Files are supplied by the operator (normally extracted from a community initramfs.cpio.gz they choose) and verified against these hashes; required groups refuse on a missing file, optional groups are included only when present and verified. A hash mismatch is reported, never silently accepted.

liverpool-gpu.needed_in: initramfs (amdgpu is built into the kernel and loads firmware before the root mounts)
liverpool-gpu.redistribution: UNKNOWN / not granted — Sony console firmware; community CI fetches it from a private repository (GayCorp/initramfs-ps4 .github/workflows)
liverpool-gpu.hash_source: meerzulee/omarchy-psx@625cb1ba manifests/ps4-initramfs.json (one console's initramfs); other consoles/firmware versions may legitimately differ

observed_in.result: all 10 files byte-identical to the hashes below

liverpool-gpu.loader_note: ps4-linux-loader@d0f4d4c (ps4-kexec-common/firmware.c) extracts 8 of these files (pfp, me, ce, mec, mec2, rlc, sdma, sdma1) from the running console at kexec time and places its cpio BEFORE the operator initramfs; files with the same path in the initramfs replace the extracted ones. liverpool_uvd.bin and liverpool_vce.bin are NOT extracted by the loader: hardware video decode/encode needs them in the initramfs.

gladius-gpu.note: amdgpu/gladius_*.bin expected; no hashes recorded yet (UNVERIFIED)

edid.note: Generic 1920x1080 EDID, used only with drm.edid_firmware=edid/1920x1080.bin. Not needed by the Orbis 6.15 kernel (ps4_bridge patch 0001 fixes 1080p60) and absent from the X-F1REBALL-X v1.0 initramfs. The loader separately writes the console's real EDID to lib/firmware/edid/my_edid.bin, which initramfs-ps4's pre_switch_root hook copies into the root.
